dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature of the trailing edge fitting a falcate spline from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute tip with a sharp pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin contour relative to the visible longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum vertical height is approximately 1.5 times the maximum horizontal base width.

other_distinctive_markers: Sharp, V-shaped tail flukes with a deep median notch and pointed tips.
